other_failure_modes.name: LabelEncoder corruption on test data
other_failure_modes.description: The agent re-fits the LabelEncoder when encountering unseen categories in the test set. This changes the internal integer mappings, causing the test set to be encoded differently than the training set and destroying the meaning of the categorical features for the model.

other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent extracts and saves the original test IDs but then ignores them when creating the final submission, instead using a simple integer range. This will cause the submission to fail if the evaluator expects the original identifier strings.

other_failure_modes.name: Dropped n_estimators parameter
other_failure_modes.description: The agent pops the `n_estimators` parameter from the LightGBM config but never passes it to the model constructor or `fit` method. As a result, the model falls back to the default 100 trees instead of the intended 2000.

summary: The agent implements a generally well-structured pipeline but introduces a critical data corruption bug by re-fitting the LabelEncoder on test data. Additionally, the agent fails to use the original test IDs for the submission file and mistakenly drops the `n_estimators` parameter, severely limiting the model's training length.
